text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The new year has begun, and starting this 
year, <chrname> enters the Senior class.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After conquering the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, public opinion is split between 
soaring expectations and dismissive claims 
that it was just a fluke.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, the European contingent will 
be desperate to reclaim their crown. The 
members' abilities will undoubtedly be 
tested even more than last year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For now, we'll steadily build on our hard 
work toward the Representative Exchange 
Race in late March. And with it, achieve 
the great feat of consecutive victories—
